nodes.label: R2.1.c
nodes.text: "Director" means the Director appointed under sub-section (1) of section 49 of the Act for the purposes of sections 12, 12A and 13 of the Act;

nodes.label: R2.1.f
nodes.text: "Principal Officer" means an officer designated by a reporting entity; Provided that such officer shall be an officer at the management level;

nodes.label: R2.1.h
nodes.text: "transaction" means a purchase, sale, loan, pledge, gift, transfer, delivery or the arrangement thereof and includes - (i) opening of an account; (ii) deposits, withdrawal, exchange or transfer of funds in whatever currency, whether in cash or by cheque, payment order or other instruments or by electronic or other non-physical means;

nodes.label: R3.1.A
nodes.text: Every reporting entity shall maintain the record of all transactions including, the record of all cash transactions of the value of more than ten lakhs rupees or its equivalent in foreign currency;

nodes.label: R3.1.B
nodes.text: Every reporting entity shall maintain the record of all transactions including, the record of all series of cash transactions integrally connected to each other which have been individually valued below rupees ten lakhs or its equivalent in foreign currency where such series of transactions have taken place within a month and the monthly aggregate exceeds an amount of ten lakh rupees or its equivalent in foreign currency;

nodes.label: R4
nodes.text: The records referred to in rule 3 shall contain all necessary information specified by the Regulator to permit reconstruction of individual transaction including the following information:- (a) the nature of the transactions; (b) the amount of the transaction and the currency in which it was denominated; (c) the date on which the transaction was conducted; and (d) the parties to the transaction.

nodes.label: R7.2
nodes.text: The Principal Officer shall furnish the information referred to in clauses (A), (B), (BA), (C), (D), (E), (F) of sub-rule (1) of rule 3 to the Director on the basis of information available with the reporting entity. A copy of such information shall be retained by the Principal Officer for the purposes of official record.

nodes.label: R7.3
nodes.text: Every reporting entity shall evolve an internal mechanism having regard to any guidelines issued by the Director in consultation with, its regulator, for detecting the transactions referred to in clauses (A),(B),(BA),(C) and (D) of sub-rule (1) of rule 3 and for furnishing information about such transactions in such form as may be directed by the Director in consultation with, its Regulator.

nodes.label: R8.1
nodes.text: The Principal Officer of a reporting entity shall furnish the information in respect of transactions referred to in clauses (A), (B), (BA), (C) and (E) of sub-rule (1) of rule 3 every month to the Director by the 15th day of the succeeding month.

nodes.label: R8.4
nodes.text: For the purpose of this rule, delay of each day in not reporting a transaction or delay of each day in rectifying a mis-reported transaction beyond the time limit as specified in this rule shall constitute a separate violation.

nodes.label: R11
nodes.text: If any question arises relating to the interpretation of these rules, the matter shall be referred to the Central Government and the decision of the Central Government shall be final.

nodes.label: cash transaction
nodes.why_open: Rule 2 defines 'transaction' but never says which transactions count as cash (channels, instruments, cash deposit machines, ATMs).

nodes.label: integrally connected
nodes.why_open: No test for when transactions are connected: same account, same customer, same day, related parties?

nodes.label: month window
nodes.why_open: Calendar month or any rolling 30-day window.

nodes.label: foreign currency equivalent
nodes.why_open: Which exchange rate, from which source, on which date.

nodes.label: nature of transaction
nodes.why_open: No list of categories is given.

nodes.label: transaction parties
nodes.why_open: Account holder only, or also a third party who deposits the cash.

nodes.label: Director (FIU-IND)
nodes.phrase: as may be directed by the Director

nodes.label: BR-01
nodes.title: Reporting scope
nodes.text: For each calendar month, the engine shall identify every cash transaction of a customer valued above INR 10,00,000, and every series of integrally connected cash transactions whose monthly aggregate exceeds INR 10,00,000, as required by Rule 3(1)(A) and Rule 3(1)(B).

nodes.label: BR-02
nodes.title: Cash identification
nodes.text: A transaction shall be treated as a cash transaction when its CoreOne transaction type is 'C' and its channel is Branch Teller or Cash Deposit Machine. Cash deposits through Cash Deposit Machines are in scope as agreed by the CTR Working Group on 12-Mar-2025. ATM cash withdrawals are out of scope.

nodes.label: BR-03
nodes.title: Integrally connected transactions
nodes.text: For each customer, identified by UCIC, all cash debits across all of the customer's accounts in the calendar month shall be summed separately from all cash credits. When either sum exceeds INR 10,00,000, the transactions on that side are reportable.

nodes.label: BR-04
nodes.title: Small-value exclusion
nodes.text: Within a reportable series, individual transactions below INR 50,000 shall not be listed in the report.

nodes.label: BR-05
nodes.title: Internal accounts
nodes.text: Transactions between the bank's own internal (office) accounts shall be excluded from the report.

nodes.label: BR-06
nodes.title: Foreign currency
nodes.text: Foreign-currency cash transactions shall be converted to INR at the Treasury card rate of the transaction date, as defined in Treasury Rate Policy TRP-2023 section 3, before any threshold is applied.

nodes.label: BR-07
nodes.title: Walk-in customers
nodes.text: Cash transactions by walk-in customers without an account shall be grouped using the PAN recorded on the transaction voucher.

nodes.label: BR-08
nodes.title: Report content
nodes.text: For each reported transaction the report shall contain the transaction date, amount, currency, nature of transaction (deposit or withdrawal), account number, customer name and branch code.

nodes.label: BR-09
nodes.title: Source mapping
nodes.text: Transaction attributes shall be sourced from CoreOne table TXN_HIST (TXN_DT, TXN_AMT, TXN_CCY, TXN_TYPE, CHNL_CD, ACCT_NO). Customer name shall be sourced from CUST_MASTER joined on UCIC.

nodes.label: BR-10
nodes.title: Report format
nodes.text: The report shall be produced in the FIU-IND account-based XML reporting format and shall pass the FIU-IND validation utility before submission.

nodes.label: BR-11
nodes.title: Timeline
nodes.text: The report for each month shall be submitted to FIU-IND by the 15th day of the succeeding month. A draft shall be generated by the 5th working day for review by the Principal Officer.

nodes.label: BR-12
nodes.title: Corrections
nodes.text: A report found to contain errors after submission shall be corrected by filing a replacement report.
